description: Physical storage locations for CUI-containing media are not secured or access-controlled. This signal indicates that media storage areas may allow unauthorized physical access.
applicability: Applicable to all physical media storage locations. Includes server rooms, tape libraries, document storage, archive facilities, and any location where CUI media is stored.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through storage facility security assessment, access control verification, and physical security audit.

sources.title: 32 CFR Part 170 - Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification Program
